title: Delivery running late
summary: Item is picked up but delivery is over the timeslot or the customer is chasing.

end: Track the agent on the dashboard.
Warn the buyer before they chase, with an ETA.

n2.q: Does the agent reply on WhatsApp?

end: Update the customer with the ETA.
Mark checked on the At Risk Dashboard.
If delivered well outside the service level, apply the late-delivery downgrade (see Late delivery partial refund).
Flag it in the group chat.
Keep the customer updated; don't promise a time you can't confirm.
